title: Concrete Revelations Wave 006 — What the Wider House Lets Us See
purpose: Use the widened Potato House as a research instrument. Each revelation connects a project operator to an external mechanism that sharpens meaning, produces a test, and opens a concrete research path. These are syntheses and discovery candidates, not claims that external scholarship secretly encodes Potatoverse doctrine.

revelations.title: The House works because good complexity is neither one blob nor isolated silos.
revelations.external_mechanism: Herbert Simon's nearly decomposable systems: strong interactions within subsystems, weaker but non-negligible interactions among subsystems make complex systems intelligible and manageable.
revelations.project_epiphany: Room ownership plus guarded Doors is not just website organization. It is a plausible architecture for cognition and research: deep local coherence, sparse typed interfaces, no requirement that every thing connect directly to everything.
concrete_test: Measure intra-Room versus cross-Room relation density.
Count interfaces whose contract is explicit versus ad hoc.
Test whether a Room can change internally without forcing unrelated Rooms to change.
Identify cross-Room edges whose removal would create dangerous isolation.
revelations.build_consequence: Graph UI should visually privilege modules/Rooms and typed interfaces rather than a hairball graph.

revelations.title: A Garden is not a pleasant place. It is a capability amplifier.
revelations.external_mechanism: Self-determination theory emphasizes autonomy, competence and relatedness; the capability approach asks whether people possess substantive opportunities rather than resources alone.
revelations.project_epiphany: The strongest Garden test is counterfactual independence: after support, are inhabitants more capable of choosing, acting, relating and continuing without permanent dependence on the Gardener?
concrete_test: Autonomy before/after participation.
Competence gain and transferable skill.
Quality of relatedness without coercive dependency.
Conversion of resources into real opportunities.
Ability to exit without catastrophic capability loss.
revelations.build_consequence: Garden dashboards should measure capability gain and future Seed, not only service outputs.

revelations.title: A Swamp can be highly resilient. Resilience is not automatically good.
revelations.external_mechanism: Social-ecological research explicitly recognizes undesirable resilient regimes, rigidity traps and poverty traps maintained by reinforcing feedbacks.
revelations.project_epiphany: The difference between Garden and Swamp is not stability versus instability. A captured or harmful regime may be extremely stable. The deeper question is whether resilience preserves generative capability or locks actors into a self-reinforcing low-option state.
concrete_test: Identify reinforcing feedbacks maintaining the state.
Measure diversity/novelty and exit options.
Ask what shocks the system absorbs by shifting costs elsewhere.
Distinguish resilience of function from resilience of a harmful arrangement.
revelations.build_consequence: State pages need desirability/capability and transformability alongside robustness.

revelations.title: Repair should not always restore the previous state.
revelations.external_mechanism: Resilience research distinguishes adaptation from transformation; when the current regime is undesirable or untenable, transformation may require reducing its resilience and crossing into a new regime.
revelations.project_epiphany: Repair has two modes: restoration when the prior configuration is worth preserving, and transformation when returning to 'normal' would recreate the mechanism of harm. This gives Forge a rigorous role: release/reorganization can open a new configuration rather than merely mend the old one.
concrete_test: Was the pre-damage state itself desirable?
Which feedbacks generated the failure?
Would restoration reproduce them?
What memory, diversity and novelty are available for reorganization?
revelations.build_consequence: Repair protocol needs a restore/adapt/transform fork.

revelations.title: The Spiral is best understood as recurrence plus reorganization, not 'upwardness'.
revelations.external_mechanism: Panarchy's adaptive cycle distinguishes growth/exploitation, conservation, release and reorganization. It is explicitly a heuristic, not a universal predictive law.
revelations.project_epiphany: Seed→growth→accumulation→release→reorganization→new Seed is a strong structural neighbor. A cycle becomes project-Spiral only when the reorganized state differs meaningfully; if the same relations recur unchanged, it is closer to Ring.
concrete_test: What potential accumulated?
How did connectedness change?
What was released?
What novel structure entered during reorganization?
Which state variable differs on return?
revelations.build_consequence: Timeline views can classify cycles as Ring, adaptive Spiral or regime transformation.

revelations.title: Shadow is not just missing information. The cause of missingness changes the inference.
revelations.external_mechanism: Missing-data theory distinguishes mechanisms such as MCAR/MAR/MNAR; when missingness depends on unobserved values, analyses based only on observed data can be systematically misleading and sensitivity assumptions become central.
revelations.project_epiphany: Shadow needs a mechanism field. 'Unknown' is insufficient. Was evidence never generated, lost randomly, inaccessible because of known variables, or hidden precisely because of what it would reveal?
concrete_test: Who or what controls observation?
Does probability of absence depend on the hidden value?
Which groups/events are disproportionately missing?
How do conclusions change under alternate missingness assumptions?
revelations.build_consequence: Every evidence dossier should support a Shadow/Missingness record and sensitivity note.

revelations.title: Fruit must be a bundle of consequences, because a single Fruit metric can rot when targeted.
revelations.external_mechanism: Goodhart-type effects occur when measures become optimization targets; an analysis of over 120 million academic papers found evidence of publishing metrics being over-optimized.
revelations.project_epiphany: Fruit cannot be 'views', revenue, citations, growth, test score or one KPI. Once a proxy becomes the target, agents can optimize the proxy while detaching from the underlying purpose.
concrete_test: What underlying end is the metric supposed to represent?
What behavior becomes profitable when the metric is targeted?
Which externalities are omitted?
Can multiple independent indicators disagree?
Does capability persist when the metric incentive disappears?
revelations.build_consequence: Fruit evaluation should always pair target metrics with externalities, persistence, capability and qualitative counterevidence.

revelations.title: A Door that connects separated worlds can become both a source of knowledge and a source of power.
revelations.external_mechanism: Network research on structural holes and brokerage finds that actors bridging disconnected groups can gain access to nonredundant information and influence resource flows.
revelations.project_epiphany: Door governance matters. A bridge is valuable because it joins separated pools, but if only one actor controls the bridge it can become a chokepoint, tollgate or distortion point. Door must therefore encode capability and power, not just passage.
concrete_test: How many alternative bridges exist?
Who can deny passage?
Who sees both sides?
What information/resource asymmetry does the broker gain?
Does the bridge increase mutual capability or broker dependence?
revelations.build_consequence: Network explorer should calculate bridge/cutpoint/betweenness properties for real institutional relations.

revelations.title: Scoped local centers are not a compromise. They may be the architecture of self-correction.
revelations.external_mechanism: Polycentric governance describes multiple centers of decision-making authority with overlapping jurisdictions, mutual adjustment and an overarching order; Ostrom-influenced research emphasizes opportunities for innovation and correction across scales.
revelations.project_epiphany: Our Local Center contract becomes much stronger: healthy plurality is not many rival global centers. It is multiple bounded centers with real discretion, overlap, feedback and constitutional constraints.
concrete_test: Does the local center have genuine decision capacity?
What jurisdiction is bounded?
How does it coordinate with overlapping centers?
Who can correct abuse or failure?
What common rules keep polycentricity from fragmenting into incoherence?
revelations.build_consequence: Room dossiers should expose jurisdiction, discretion, overlap and correction channels.

revelations.title: Research Lab and Canon are a necessary pair: exploration without exploitation dissipates; exploitation without exploration self-destructs.
revelations.external_mechanism: James March's exploration–exploitation model shows that adaptive organizations often learn exploitation faster; this can generate short-run effectiveness but long-run self-destructive lock-in if exploration is starved.
revelations.project_epiphany: Research Lab is not a junk drawer. It is the project's protected exploration budget. Canon/Rooms exploit and refine reliable knowledge; Research Lab generates variation and strange bridges. Promotion and demotion are the membrane between them.
concrete_test: What fraction of effort goes to exploitation vs exploration?
How often do new hypotheses enter canon?
How often is canon challenged by outside evidence?
Does the system reward only locally successful routines?
revelations.build_consequence: House pulse should track exploration, promotion, failed hypotheses and canon revision rates.

revelations.title: An institution can keep its Spirit-language while its Mind and Body quietly defect.
revelations.external_mechanism: Organization research distinguishes policy–practice and means–ends decoupling; recent mission-drift work emphasizes gradual, unintended practice drift.
revelations.project_epiphany: Spirit/Mind/Body is not just a descriptive triad. It becomes a diagnostic for institutional integrity: mission/values, decision metrics/processes and money/assets/labour can be compared longitudinally.
concrete_test: Does public mission match internal decision criteria?
Do budgets and incentives reward the stated end?
Do practices generate the claimed outcome?
When drift occurs, was it deliberate adaptation or unnoticed divergence?
revelations.build_consequence: Entity dossiers should support a Mission → Decision Rules → Resource Flows → Outcomes trace.

revelations.title: Roots are not just origins. Some past choices remain active because they change the payoff of future choices.
revelations.external_mechanism: Path-dependence research models increasing returns: timing and sequence can make initially contingent paths self-reinforcing and hard to reverse.
revelations.project_epiphany: A Root is strongest when it is an active historical constraint, not merely an ancestor. The project should distinguish genealogical provenance from path-dependent mechanism.
concrete_test: Which early choice changed later switching costs?
What complementary institutions accumulated around it?
Which feedback rewards staying on the path?
What critical juncture created alternative possibilities?
revelations.build_consequence: History pages should mark roots as provenance-only, causal, or path-dependent.

revelations.title: Culture is not a cloud above institutions. It is a feedback engine between people, transmission technologies and institutions.
revelations.external_mechanism: Cultural-dynamics and cultural-transmission research studies micro transmission, micro–macro aggregation and feedback between culture, institutions and socioeconomic environments.
revelations.project_epiphany: Culture should be modeled as a loop: person/practice → transmission channel → population distribution → institution/incentive → changed transmission conditions. This finally gives Culture concrete edges rather than only content categories.
concrete_test: What trait/practice is transmitted?
By which channel and learning bias?
What institution amplifies or suppresses it?
How does prevalence feed back into incentives or law?
What is retained across generations?
revelations.build_consequence: Culture Room needs transmission graphs and lineage/time views.

revelations.title: Healthy connection is not maximum connection.
revelations.external_mechanism: Complex-network research shows robustness depends on topology, modularity, hierarchy, interdependence and coupled dynamics; local failures can cascade through highly interconnected systems.
revelations.project_epiphany: Spirit/circulation does not mean connect everything to everything. House health may require modularity, redundancy, multiple routes and controlled coupling. Some Doors should be narrow because they contain failure.
concrete_test: What failures cascade across modules?
Where is redundancy?
Which interfaces are single points of failure?
What edges create useful integration versus contagious risk?
revelations.build_consequence: House graph should expose single points of failure and alternate paths.

revelations.title: The rarest value may already exist publicly, but in disconnected literatures.
revelations.external_mechanism: Literature-based discovery formalizes undiscovered public knowledge: A–B relations in one literature and B–C relations in another can motivate an A–C hypothesis not explicitly stated in either.
revelations.project_epiphany: The House's cross-Room structure can become a discovery engine. The most valuable query is often not 'what do we know about A?' but 'what mechanisms in A also occur in a distant Room C, and what bridge B survives source-level checking?'
concrete_test: Are A-B and B-C independently established?
Are literatures genuinely separated?
Is B mechanistic rather than poetic?
What observation would reject A-C?
Is the resulting question useful?
revelations.build_consequence: Research Lab should store bridge dossiers and suggest cross-Room B candidates.

revelations.title: Purpose looks less like one hidden destination and more like a continuously tested alignment.
revelations.external_mechanism: Meaning-in-life research separates coherence, purpose/direction and mattering; self-determination emphasizes autonomy, competence and relatedness; capability theory adds substantive opportunity.
revelations.project_epiphany: A purpose can feel profound and still be underdeveloped if it is incoherent, externally controlled, impossible to enact, relationally corrosive or barren in Fruit. Purpose is better treated as Spirit–Mind–Body alignment repeatedly tested against life.
concrete_test: Does the story make sense under evidence?
Is the direction genuinely endorsed?
Does it matter beyond status?
Are skills and real opportunities growing?
Does it strengthen honest relation?
What Fruit appears?
revelations.build_consequence: Purpose reader should be an iterative compass, not a purpose oracle.

meta_revelations: The project is converging on mechanism rather than motif: the same symbol becomes valuable when it names a testable relation.
Many apparently moral oppositions are actually regime distinctions: stable/unstable, open/closed, connected/disconnected and high/low are not inherently good/bad.
The House's strongest scientific neighbor is the architecture of complex adaptive systems: modularity, interfaces, feedback, path dependence, resilience, transformation and multi-scale control.
The strongest human-purpose neighbor is capability: meaning becomes real when a person can convert values and understanding into substantive action.
The strongest epistemic neighbor is missingness/provenance/discovery: what is absent, disconnected or uncited can be as important as what is present.
The next site architecture should be question-first and entity-first. Symbols should appear as analytic operators invoked by the question, not as the destination.
next_research_programmes: Apply House/Shell/Garden/Swamp/Shadow/Fruit to 3-5 concrete institutions longitudinally using public records.
Build a Shadow audit over one archive: classify missingness, source control and sensitivity.
Build one culture transmission graph from a meme/idea through platform, subculture, institution and policy response.
Build one path-dependence dossier showing a Root that is still causally active.
Build one network Door/brokerage case showing both information advantage and chokepoint risk.
Build one Repair case where restoration versus transformation gives different prescriptions.
Build one literature-based-discovery A-B-C query across two Rooms and seek disconfirming evidence before promotion.
